name: Koto Strings
description: A panel of thirteen strings you strum with the pointer, each vibrating as a real string does and, if sound is on, playing a soft synthesised pluck.

props.name: strings
props.description: How many strings cross the panel, from 1 to 25. They thicken slightly from the top string to the bottom one, and the bottom string is the lowest note.

props.name: sound
props.description: Play a quiet plucked note for each pluck, synthesised on the spot and tuned to a hirajoshi scale from D4 at the bottom string upward. Sound only starts after the visitor has interacted with the page, and no audio context is made while it is off.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the vibration envelope, the glow at night and the keyboard marker. Any CSS colour or variable.

props.name: decay
props.description: Seconds a plucked string takes to come to rest. Higher modes die away sooner than the fundamental. The sound rings for about as long.

props.name: onPluck
props.description: Called once for every pluck with the string's index (0 is the top string) and a strength from 0 to 1. Faster crossings pluck harder.

props.name: ref
props.description: Gives pluck(index, strength?) to pluck one string, and strum({ direction, at, duration, strength }) to sweep across them all, through the same motion as the pointer.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the panel, which is a vertical toolbar with one button per string. Tab reaches it once; the arrow keys, Home and End move between strings, and Space or Enter plucks.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the panel. It is h-80 and full width by default. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
